newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's construction shares lose ground.
newsitem.headline: Japan's construction shares lose ground.

text.p: Shares in Japan's construction sector lost ground on Wednesday, with many issues hitting their lows for the financial year, dragged down by a report that the government would review its public works spending plan.
By midday, the share price of Kumagai Gumi Co Ltd slipped 15 yen to 169 yen. It briefly fell to 165 yen, a low for fiscal 1996/97.
Aoki Corp slipped 10 yen to 146 yen, Fujita Corp lost nine to 179 yen and Hazama Corp eased 10 yen to 245 yen. All three hit lows for the financial year this morning.

The Japanese financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Wednesday that the government and the ruling Liberal Democratic Party plan to review a 630-trillion-yen public-works spending programme covering a 10-year period to March 2005.
The paper said they would seek to extend the 10-year period by two years, which would reduce spending on an annual basis.
